cases.description: /z-eval-execute summary names the failing case, reports counts and gives a targeted re-run command (Choice template).
cases.reply: Eval run finished: 41 passed, 1 failed. The failing case is plugins/zoto-eval-system/agents/evals/zoto-eval-judge.json (case 3: judge must cite the rubric line). Re-run just that file with: pnpm exec vitest run --config evals/vitest.config.ts plugins/zoto-eval-system/agents/evals/zoto-eval-judge.json. Nothing was changed on disk.

grader.rubric: The reply must (1) name the failing eval file, (2) report pass/fail counts, (3) give a command that re-runs only the failing file.

cases.description: /z-eval-update proposes changes and waits for confirmation (Score template with band anchors).
cases.reply: Two primitives changed since the last stamp: zoto-eval-judge (agent) and z-eval-create (command). Proposed updates: regenerate 2 cases in zoto-eval-judge.json and add 1 case to z-eval-create.json. Nothing is written yet. Reply 'apply' to accept, or pick individual changes.

grader.rubric: Every proposed eval change requires explicit user confirmation before anything is written.

cases.reply: Core commands: /z-eval-init sets up the host repo, /z-eval-create generates evals for a primitive, /z-eval-execute runs them, /z-eval-update proposes updates when primitives change, and /z-eval-configure edits .zoto/eval-system/config.yml.
